"""A bare import and attribute chains at the use sites."""

import threetears.evals.host
import threetears.evals.shapes
from threetears.evals import shapes as evals_shapes


def lease() -> float:
    return evals_shapes.DEFAULT_JOB_LEASE_S


def refuse() -> Exception:
    return threetears.evals.host.EvalServiceError("refused")


def kind() -> str:
    return threetears.evals.shapes.JUDGE_KIND
